name: Fading Light
detailed_description:
Journey Through the Shadows of a Forgotten World

Step into Fading Light, a metroidvania adventure set in a mysterious and dangerous world, where survival depends on your wits and your unlikely companion, Spark. Explore a twilight land filled with peril, where every shadow holds a threat, and every step forward uncovers new secrets. In this dark and treacherous environment, you'll play as Noteo, a resourceful survivor from a hidden tribe, with Spark, a curious firefolk companion by your side. Together, you’ll navigate through ancient ruins, face terrifying creatures, and uncover the mysteries that lie hidden beneath the darkness.

Game Features

Metroidvania Exploration: Traverse a vast, interconnected world filled with dangerous biomes, each with its own distinct environments, creatures, and challenges. The world is designed for discovery, allowing you to explore, fight, and uncover secrets at your own pace.

Two Character Cooperation: Master the unique abilities of Noteo while relying on Spark’s light and support as you progress through the game. Work together to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and face the dangers lurking in the shadows.

Challenging Boss Battles: Each biome culminates in a climactic boss fight, where strategy and quick reflexes are essential. These battles are designed to test your mastery of Noteo’s skills and your teamwork with Spark. 

Crafting and Survival: Collect materials from the world around you to craft tools, weapons, and items that will aid in your survival. Adapt to the ever-changing threats and overcome the hostile environment.

Light and Darkness: In a world where light is scarce, Spark is your greatest ally. Keep him close, as he’s the only thing standing between you and the overwhelming darkness of this forgotten land.

Immersive Storytelling: Experience the story through the gameplay itself, with a blend of environmental storytelling, voice-acted dialogue, and subtle narrative cues that enrich the world without breaking the pace of the action. 

Accessible to All Players: While Fading Light offers a challenging adventure, an accessibility mode ensures that players of all types can enjoy the game at their own pace. 

Atmospheric Soundtrack: A dynamic soundtrack accompanies you through each area, enhancing the tension, beauty, and danger of the world you explore.

Survive the Darkness

As you journey deeper into this mysterious world, you'll uncover more than you could ever imagine. With Spark lighting the way, will you have what it takes to survive the darkness and discover the truth hidden within?

short_description: In a world of eternal darkness, navigate the unknown with only the glow of your companion, Spark. Craft arrows from the environment to survive, uncover lost secrets of an ancient world, and push forward through the shadows into hope. Will you find your way, or will the dark consume you?
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround sound support

content_descriptors.notes: Fading Light includes scenes of blood and violence primarily in the context of combat against fantasy creatures. The game explores themes of survival in a harsh, dark world, which may include intense encounters with monstrous entities.
